name: com.pandanakami.udonsharpplus
description: Editor-only extension that lets UdonSharp compile more of C#: interfaces, plain classes, generics, List / Dictionary, lambdas, LINQ (including GroupBy), delegates, local functions, anonymous types, tuples, operator overloading, coroutines, and switch patterns and expressions. Applied with Harmony patches; depends on UdonSharp internals of VRChat Worlds SDK 3.10.x.
